## Rule

**Horizontal 2× tile.** For an H×W color grid, output is H×2W with the active columns
copied twice, left→right: `output[r,c] = input[r, c mod W]` for `c < 2W`, else background.
Colors pass through (incl. color 0). W∈{3,4,5}, H∈{3,4,5} in visible+arc-gen (data-dependent W
must be detected at runtime). Output MUST be the full `[1,10,30,30]` one-hot canvas — compact
widths are visible-0 (`hard_records/compact_output_shape.md`). Encode (per
`profile_real_cost.encode`): within-grid cells one-hot incl. channel-0 for background;
outside-grid cells (r≥H or c≥W) all-zero; **col 29 is always all-zero** (used as the
background-fill gather target).

## Algorithm sketch

```
# input x: [1,10,30,30] one-hot.  W detected from whether cols 3,4 of row0 are active.
W = 3 + (col3_active) + (col4_active)              # row in {0,1,2}
idx10 = [j % W for j in range(2W)] + [29]*(10-2W)  # per-W tile pattern, len 10
idx   = idx10 + [29]*20                             # pad to len 30 (col 29 = all-zero)
output = x[:, :, :, idx]                            # Gather axis=3 -> [1,10,30,30] (free output)
```

## Cost analysis

**Live 219 = memory 176 + params 43** (`profile=static`, no gap). The forced dominant term is
the final **`idx[30]` int32 = 120 B** gather index (68% of memory) — ORT's Gather/GatherElements/
GatherND require int32/int64 indices (int8/uint8/int16/uint16 → `INVALID_GRAPH`, tested), and the
index length = output width = 30. Remaining: index-construction 73 (idx_bank[3,10] 30p + idx10[10]
40 B + Pad 3p) and W-probe 26 (probe_w 10p + probe_cols 8 B + 2 scalars 8 B). **120+73+26 = 219 is a
proven floor** — full forced-component argument + scorer facts in
`hard_records/free_output_tile_floor_219.md`. WALL: no sub-219 formulation found across 3
independent from-scratch families (see Attempts table).
